text:
𝗭𝗜𝗠 𝗪𝗜𝗡 𝗕𝗬 𝟱𝟳! 🇿🇼🔥

Zimbabwe beat Afghanistan in the 2nd Test at Sharjah to take the series 1-0.
Afghanistan fell short chasing 418: 360 all out. Debutant Naseer Khan made 101*.

So close for Afghanistan 💔
#AFGvZIM #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗭𝗜𝗠𝗕𝗔𝗕𝗪𝗘 𝗡𝗘 𝗝𝗘𝗘𝗧𝗜 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦! 🇿🇼🔥
👉 Sharjah mein 2nd Test Zimbabwe ne 57 run se jeeta, series 1-0
👉 Zimbabwe: 339 & 295/9d
👉 Afghanistan ko 418 ka target mila, 360 pe all out
👉 Debutant Naseer Khan ne 101* banaya, par kaafi nahi pada

Afghanistan sirf 57 run door reh gaya! Kya aapko lagta hai wo jeet sakte the? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #AFGvZIM #Cricket
